name: Estate Reserve Pour-Over (V60)
description: Slowly hand-dripped Chikmagalur single-estate heirloom beans with tasting notes of wild bergamot, candied stone fruit, and a clean wildflower honey finish.

name: Smoked Vanilla Bean Cortado
description: Equal parts double ristretto and velvety textured steamed milk, infused with house-cured Madagascar vanilla pod syrup and a whisper of smoked sea salt.

name: Kyoto 18-Hour Cold Drip
description: Slowly extracted droplet by droplet over 18 hours through our Japanese glass tower. Winey body, notes of dark cocoa nibs and black cherry over hand-carved ice sphere.
notes: Cold Extraction • Zero Acidity • Served Chilled

name: Brown Butter Oat Milk Latte
description: Our signature espresso pulled over slow-browned butter reduction, blended with silky steamed Swedish oat milk and dusted with fresh Ceylon cinnamon.

name: Velvet Flat White
description: Double shot of our rich House Espresso blend cut with a thin veil of glossy microfoam. Intense roasted hazelnut notes with a buttery crema mouthfeel.

name: Tonic Espresso Fizz
description: Bright, effervescent artisanal Indian tonic water layered with an espresso float, fresh rosemary sprig, and dehydrated blood orange wheel.

name: Affogato al Caramello
description: Two scoops of artisanal Madagascar vanilla gelato drowned in a piping hot double shot of dark chocolatey espresso, drizzled with burnt caramel drizzle.

name: Silver Needle First Flush White Tea
description: Tender unopened tea buds hand-plucked from the mist-covered slopes of Darjeeling. Pale champagne liquor with faint floral muscatel and melon sweetness.

name: Ceremonial Uji Matcha Latte
description: First-harvest ceremonial grade green tea stone-ground in Kyoto, whisked with traditional bamboo chasen and folded with creamy steamed almond or oat milk.
notes: Kyoto Import • Vibrant Green • Umami Sweet

name: Spiced Amber Masala Chai Pot
description: Full-bodied Assam CTC simmered slowly with green cardamom, fresh crushed ginger, cinnamon bark, tellicherry peppercorn, and whole organic milk in a clay teapot.
notes: Authentic Clay Pot • Warm Spice Blend

name: Wild Hibiscus & Rosehip Infusion
description: Crimson caffeine-free herbal brew featuring sun-dried Egyptian hibiscus petals, whole crushed rosehips, fresh mint leaves, and raw Himalayan honey.
notes: Caffeine-Free • Tart & Floral • Vitamin C Rich

name: Smoked Lapsang Souchong
description: Historic Chinese black tea leaves smoke-dried over pine embers. Deep amber liquor with an aromatic resinous fireplace aroma and surprisingly smooth, sweet undertone.
notes: Pine Smoked • Bold Character • Savory Finish

name: Lavender Chamomile Nightcap
description: Organic whole Egyptian chamomile florets infused with French culinary lavender buds, dried lemon balm, and a gentle touch of clover blossom honey.

name: 36-Hour Country Sourdough Loaf
description: Naturally fermented over 36 hours with our century-old sourdough mother. Blistered, caramelized mahogany crust cradling a tender, open, custard-like crumb with mild lactic tang.
notes: Whole Stoneground Wheat & Rye • Wild Yeast

name: Normandy Butter Pain au Chocolat
description: Hand-laminated with 84% butterfat cultured French butter for 72 gossamer layers of flaky puff, encasing twin batons of Valrhona 66% dark chocolate.

name: Roasted Pistachio Cardamom Knot
description: Soft twisted brioche braid laden with freshly crushed green cardamom seed paste and roasted Iranian pistachios, brushed with fragrant orange blossom glaze.

name: Rosemary Olive & Sea Salt Focaccia
description: High-hydration Roman dough dimpled by hand, generously pooled with cold-pressed Tuscan olive oil, fresh garden rosemary sprigs, and crunchy Maldon flake sea salt.
notes: High Hydration • Extra Virgin Olive Oil

name: Twice-Baked Almond Croissant
description: Day-old classic croissant drenched in citrus vanilla syrup, stuffed generously with rich almond frangipane cream, and showered with toasted almond flakes.

name: Heirloom Tomato & Whipped Ricotta Danish
description: Crisp flaky pastry nest cradling herb-whipped lemon ricotta, slow-roasted rainbow cherry tomatoes, toasted pine nuts, and a balsamic reduction drizzle.

name: Kouign-Amann (Breton Butter Cake)
description: The crown jewel of Brittany baking: caramelized croissant dough rolled in demerara sugar that melts into a crackling, glassy shell with a tender, buttery core.

name: Truffled Forest Wild Mushroom Toast
description: Thick slice of toasted country sourdough crowned with pan-seared oyster and shiitake mushrooms, creamy garlic thyme emulsion, shaved Grana Padano, and white truffle oil.

name: Smoked Salmon & Caper Eggs Benedict
description: Two organic pasture-raised poached eggs, hand-cured Norwegian smoked salmon, and crisp arugula atop toasted English sourdough muffin, blanketed in silky Meyer lemon hollandaise.

name: Hass Avocado & Whipped Feta Tartine
description: Ripe crushed avocado on toasted seed bread, herb-marinated whipped goat feta, pickled shallots, pomegranate jewels, toasted hemp hearts, and cold-pressed chili oil.

name: Turkish Poached Cilbir Eggs
description: Pasture-raised soft poached eggs set over thick garlic-dill labneh, spooned with warm Aleppo pepper brown butter sauce, served with freshly torn toasted sourdough for dipping.

name: Smoked Pancetta & Cheddar Brioche Melt
description: Crisp dry-cured pancetta, sharp aged English cheddar, caramelized shallot jam, and slow-fried egg nestled between golden pan-grilled artisan brioche slices.

name: Wild Berry Acai & Hemp Granola Bowl
description: Thick antioxidant acai berry puree blended with frozen bananas and almond milk, topped with house-baked maple pecan granola, fresh blueberries, chia seeds, and coconut curls.

name: Shakshuka al Forno with Feta
description: Cast-iron skillet of spiced roasted red bell peppers, smoked paprika, cumin, and San Marzano tomatoes, gently poaching two farm eggs, sprinkled with crumbled barrel-aged feta.

name: Burnt Basque Cheesecake with Espresso Caramel
description: Intentionally scorched mahogany crust giving way to an irresistibly molten, silky cream center, served warm with a drizzle of house espresso salted caramel sauce.

name: Single Origin Dark Chocolate Hazelnut Tart
description: Pate sablee chocolate pastry shell filled with 70% Single Origin Ecuadorian chocolate ganache, roasted Piedmont hazelnut praline, and gold leaf flake.

name: Meyer Lemon & Earl Grey Meringue Tart
description: Butter pastry shell holding a zingy Meyer lemon curd infused with bergamot Earl Grey tea, topped with towering torched Italian meringue peaks.

name: Classic Venetian Tiramisu in Coppa
description: House-baked savoiardi ladyfingers soaked in our single-origin espresso and Marsala wine, layered with airy zabaglione mascarpone mousse and Dutch dark cocoa.

name: Warm Wild Cardamom Cinnamon Bun
description: Fluffy coiled sourdough brioche generously packed with aromatic Ceylon cinnamon, cracked wild cardamom, and brown sugar, smothered in whipped cream cheese frosting.

name: Tahitian Vanilla Mille-Feuille
description: Three wafer-thin layers of caramelized puff pastry alternating with rich Tahitian vanilla bean mousseline cream and dusted with confectioner's sugar.
